PreToolUse.matcher: tool_name == 'Bash' && tool_input.command =~ 'prisma db push|prisma migrate deploy'

hooks.command: echo '[HOOK] WARNING: prisma db push detected — run /prisma-check first to confirm schema matches DB state!' >&2
echo '[HOOK] BLOCKED: Force push is not allowed. Use --force-with-lease or ask the user to confirm.' >&2; exit 1
echo '[HOOK] E2E run complete. If all tests pass, commit the fixes.' >&2
